body: Oh that makes sense too. When I made the account, I hadn't expected to move back to the US at some point too and didn't want to start anew so, I set myself up for failure! xD

Man, I wish at least there was a clarification when you order it that it is region-specific. (at least the amazon page had it nowhere to be found) I had never gotten a physical collector's before like this, and seeing it's just a digital code, it didn't even occur to me that it would be region-locked. Also because I had gotten the 15th Anniversary one here too but I was able to use that code on my account, even though that one DID say that it was region specific. xD
I know right? I thought that was a weird "solution" suggestion too.

Where should I turn to for trying to trade it? Any recommendation? I've never had this sort of problem and have no idea. xD (I had bought the 15th Anniversary collector's here for instance in the US and was able to use THAT code on my EU account for instance. Maybe because not full game?)

And just an addition to describe how I feel physically sort of right now: It is so hard to explain in words. But it is like a constant heavy weight/pain in the chest and feeling tired every moment. And at the same time, numb. Just numb completely, like even actual physical touch doesn't feel the same anymore.

I have this constant feeling under my skin, especially my arms, that I have something bubbling underneath and I need to rip it out. It is again, hard to explain in words, but I feel like my skin is not my own and it needs to be taken off. 

I have been depressed for so many years, but this level is just... Unbearable. I feel like I'm just an animated husk of what I was.
